findings: Full 3528x126 PNG contains all 16 readable Stage labels, complete rectangular nodes and 15 right-facing connector arrows; none are clipped at image boundaries.
The 1028x760 product screenshot retains normal text and node dimensions, with the first four stages and part of the fifth visible in an overflowing diagram region; a horizontal scrollbar is visible.
Read-only DOM evidence reports naturalWidth=3528 and rendered width=3528, naturalHeight=126 and rendered height=126 at devicePixelRatio=1, corroborating no fit-to-width flattening.
Both Parser and View labels, Component TypeScript annotation, and descriptions remain legible as black text on light-blue fill in the raw PNG and product screenshot.
The Presents label sits above the connecting line; the arrowhead points into View and is distinguishable from the text.
Actual PNG is 564x118 with nonwhite content bounded approximately 15 pixels from every outer edge, removing the formerly oversized blank viewBox without cropping nodes or labels.
Minor cosmetic defect: the white Presents label backing touches and partially erases roughly one pixel of the View left outline near x=331,y=40..54; text, arrow and node interior remain readable.
c4.contrastMethod: WCAG relative luminance of observed solid black and opaque fill pixels; not a per-glyph raster contrast certification.

limitations: Only these two light-theme fixtures and their corresponding product screenshots were visually inspected; this is not a full Windows diagram/theme corpus review.
The retained wide screenshot shows the left end and a scrollbar; no screenshot of the far-right scrolled UI or pointer-driven horizontal traversal was supplied for this review.
One recorded devicePixelRatio=1 configuration; no system DPI matrix, real IME or installer acceptance is established.
The source harness report is preserved unchanged, including its original visualReviewAccepted=false; this supplemental review does not assert human sign-off or all visual cases passed.
